brief: One design in three states. Really Bad Chess-style colour (white board, black hatching, bright blue for legal moves, coral only for snails) on a chess.com-style layout, arranged with Proven / Better / New.

candidates.name: Your move
candidates.concept: Nothing selected: the only colour on the board is the snails and where they land next.
traits: Snail countdown in the app bar centre
Snail distance in each player's clock slot

candidates.name: Bishop selected
candidates.concept: Tap a piece and every legal square lights up bright blue; a legal square the snail will land on keeps a coral ring.
traits: Legal squares from the real engine (snail walls respected)
Hatching stays visible through the blue

candidates.name: Rules
candidates.concept: The ? button or Rules opens five one-line rules in a bottom sheet.
traits: Numbered black chips match the board's ink
